entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Good evening.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry to barge in like this...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He was quite considerate.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Thank you for agreeing to spend this[n]time with me.
Make yourself at home.[clr 27]
What should we do today?
It's not too cold, is it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have a few ideas.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's okay... I wanted to come here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh yes, I... I want you to have this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I considered making it by hand...[n]Would you have preferred that?
There's always next year.[clr 27]
Anything from you is perfect.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... Look forward to it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That sounds like something a guy at[n]a host club would say.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Still... I'm glad we're able to be here[n]together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wanted to give my first Valentine's Day[n]chocolate... directly to you.
You mean a lot to me, too.[clr 27]
Did I worry you?
Is this really for me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It makes me happy to hear you say that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you think?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course it is...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I've been studying hard. I'm looking to[n]apply to law school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My dream of becoming a police[n]commissioner remains the same.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know I can do it... especially with[n]your help.
I'm kinda worried.
You got this, honor student.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not a child...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know that's not me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So... what I really wanted to talk to you[n]about is...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're going back next month, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What will happen... to us?
Nothing will change.[clr 27]
What do you want?
Come with me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Yes. Yes, you're right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean it that way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A-Are you serious?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, there was a lot I wanted to say,[n]but none of it matters now that we're here[n]together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: After all that waiting, living in different[n]places doesn't seem like such a big deal.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And... I've been waiting for you[n]for so long.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not asking too much... am I?
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Makoto...
